basic_info.description: This charming 3-bedroom,2.5 bath center patio home offers the perfect blend of indoor-outdoor living in the flats of Noe Valley. Boasting an exceptionally large(114 ft deep), beautifully landscaped garden, this home provides a lush and private escape ideal for relaxing, entertaining, or gardening.  Situated in an unbeatable location with a 99 Walk Score, you're just 1.5 blocks from Church Street, where cafes, shops, and transit options are right at your doorstep including half a block to shuttle pick ups. Enjoy a sunny south-facing living room with a fireplace, a formal dining room with period details, and a chef's kitchen featuring a 6-burner professional range, large operable skylight, and a cozy breakfast nook with original built-ins. The main level has two bedrooms, a full bath in addition to a newly added guest half bath. French doors lead directly to the garden from both bedrooms. Downstairs, the spacious primary suite opens directly to the garden, creating a serene retreat with its generous layout, and en-suite bath featuring large walk-in shower w/ bench. Additional features include a two-car garage with EV charger and tons of additional storage. Deep, picturesque yard with a stone patio help make this a true urban oasis.
